title: Edgar Mitchell's last filmed interview: a secret group withholding UFO information

tellings.quote: we we got down to brass tacks, and yes, that's that's exactly what he said. He told me who he talked with.

plain: In what is described as his last filmed interview, at his home around 2015 or 2016, the astronaut Edgar Mitchell said that a secret group was holding back information about UFOs. Jeremy Corbell, who did the interview, tells Michels that when they got down to brass tacks, "that's exactly what he said," and that Mitchell told him who he had talked with. Coming from Mitchell, it would mean a man of his standing believed the information was being deliberately kept from the public.
